node.title: Re^3: Detect whether a writeable filehandle has closed?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Are you suggesting that that might be able to detect a filehandle "gone bad"? My problem is not that the open fails, but that the filehandle goes bad (apparently being closed by the child) some time after opening.

I see now what you mean, my assumption from the "Detect whether a writeable filehandle has closed?" was that you're looking at the filehandle on your end, but you're asking about the other end of the pipe. Sorry, [doc://fileno] doesn't help with that, only if your filehandle closes (i.e. $pipe in your example [id://11126858|here]).

You might want to look at [mod://IPC::Run], it has a pumpable method that seems more like what you're asking for. I've also used its pump_nb method inside an [doc://eval] to detect when a child process has gone bad.

Minor edits.
